feed.headline: Russia and Iran criticise US Caspian task force as study outlines joint sanction evasion
feed.ai: After CENTCOM affirmed it would maintain the naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and block the IRGC’s land and Caspian routes, Russia called this special taskforce a 'clear violation of international law'. At the same time, the Institute for the Study of War devoted its latest assessment to Tehran-Moscow cooperation in circumventing US arms restrictions.

feed.headline: Russia hit by second car bomb in as many days as peace talks continue
feed.ai: A former adviser to Ukraine's pro-Putin ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov was seriously hurt, Russia says.

feed.headline: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says it makes sense for European leaders to be involved as Ukraine hopes to eventually join the EU.

feed.headline: One of France’s Most Popular Athletes Is Running for President
feed.ai: Centrists want alternatives to a matchup between the far right and far left in the 2027 presidential race. Enter Christine Lagarde, a former central banker — and Teddy Riner, a judo star.

feed.headline: Army Officer Accused of Trying to Spy for Russia Is Afghan War Veteran
feed.ai: The officer, who served at a NATO base in Britain, is expected to be charged in the coming days, two officials said.

feed.headline: In Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner Ask Putin to Include Europe in Peace Talks
feed.ai: In Dublin, President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine said Europeans would join the next round of talks. Russia has not confirmed that.

feed.headline: A.I. Weapons Need Data for Their Training. Ukraine Has a Lot to Offer.
feed.ai: The Ukrainian government has opened up a trove of five million battlefield videos to defense companies at home and abroad.

feed.headline: Protesters Throw Projectiles at Biden During Dublin Trip
feed.ai: Video showed demonstrators from a pro-Palestinian protest throwing projectiles at former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. after he attended an event at Trinity College Dublin on Tuesday.

feed.headline: Azerbaijan intensifies its European engagement at the EPC Summit
feed.ai: Azerbaijan added additional thrust to its engagement with Europe announcing more energy to the EU, a strategic partnership with the UK, additional agreements with Ukraine, a dozen bilateral meetings with European leaders and a new meeting with Armenia to advance the historic peace process.

feed.headline: Turkey: Six-metre Trojan Horse spills plastic waste at COP31
feed.ai: A giant Trojan Horse overflowing with plastic waste has appeared in Antalya as Greenpeace International staged a striking environmental protest during the COP31 climate summit. Created with Danish artist Thomas Dambo, the Greenpeace installation warns of the environmental impact of plastics.

feed.headline: How a new ‘green energy corridor’ from the Caspian Sea could help Eastern Europe kick fossil fuels
feed.ai: The partnership signed at the COP31 climate summit aims to transform Azerbaijan into an interregional electricity hub.

feed.headline: Portugal: Humanoid robots take centre stage at Web Summit 2026
feed.ai: Dancing humanoid robots and robotic dogs stole the show at Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon. The technology conference has generated nearly €2.5 billion for Portugal's economy over the past decade, according to a study.
